column1: 1. To update a field: click the cell and type the new value, then press Enter.
2. Each row below the header is one fundraiser.
3. Fundraiser ID must be short, lowercase, and unique (no spaces). It is used in the page web address.
4. Icon is a single emoji shown on the card.
5. Enter Goal and Current Total as plain numbers. Dollar signs and commas are okay.
6. Dates can be written however you like (e.g. Sep 1 2026).
7. Do NOT change the column headers (the row directly below).
Additional Funds — flat dollar amount for any money raised outside the fundraisers listed below (e.g. donations, grants). Set to 0 if nothing extra.
